about_the_game: Play as a clerk in this new FPS (First Person Scanning) game by rotating and scanning customers' groceries. With a wide variety of maps and different challenges, this is unlike anything you've ever played before.
detailed_description: Play as a clerk in this new FPS (First Person Scanning) game by rotating and scanning customers' groceries. With a wide variety of maps and different challenges, this is unlike anything you've ever played before.
name: ScanIt! Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970 4GB or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Sound Device

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700

short_description: You take on the role of a clerk working at a store, tasked with scanning items for each customer. The game introduces a unique gameplay mechanic that focuses on item manipulation, adding a layer of challenge and engagement and introducing a fresh twist to the simulation genre.
